, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misframed the task from the start by insisting on finding a precise current street address/ZIP for the stadium instead of the location description the question asks for. The correct answer is the intersection “North Avenue at Techwood Drive,” which was even visible in the sources the WebSurfer surfaced.
